from scipy.optimize import least_squares
y=dA_dt
def m1(p):
    f=p[0]+p[1]*t+p[2]*t**2
    g=p[3]+p[4]*t
    n=p[5]+p[6]*t
    return f+g*A**n+p[7]*A
def m2(p):
    # exponent with t, g exp in t
    f=p[0]+p[1]*t
    g=p[2]*np.exp(p[3]*t)
    n=p[4]+p[5]*t
    return f+g*A**n+p[6]*A
